quote: The UCD Veterinary Hospital is a unique environment, providing a primary and referral service to the public and veterinary profession.
Cases are seen by appointment only

We are an Independent Veterinary Clinic located in the heart of Donnybrook that provides personalised pet care through a wide range of Veterinary Services looking after your pet to keep them healthy and safe.
Our out of hours service, when we are closed, is provided by the Pet Emergency Hospital in Belfield UCD.
Dublin's Cat Only Veterinary Practice Based in Clonsilla, Dublin.

We offer emergency veterinary care for our clients in Meath and Dublin, with our team of vets and nurses available at our Village Vets Clonsilla and Village Vets Dundrum hospitals seven days a week, including bank holidays.
We are Ireland’s Only ISFM Certified Cat-Friendly Practice.
Our first-aid veterinary clinic in Ballymun runs every Tuesday evening from 5:00 PM to 6:30 PM, providing essential care for pets in need.
We also run a first aid veterinary clinic in Ballymun on Tuesday evenings between 5pm and 6.30pm.
Holistic veterinary service; we combine a scientific approach to diagnosis with competencies in homeopathy, nutrition, nutriceuticals & pharmaceuticals.
Village Vets Kilmainham is led by Marte, who has led the clinic since Village Vets took over the site from Carey & Keane Veterinary Clinic in 2021.
If your pet needs urgent care, call us on (01) 679 1975 straight away. For after-hours emergencies, visit our Emergency Care page for your nearest 24/7 location and what to do next.
Free client parking is available on-site.
